AND itg.TMP_CNAME like '%'||#{TmpCName}||'%'

SELECT TMP_ENAME AS id, TMP_CNAME AS text FROM INTERF_TEMPLATE_GROUP itg where 1=1
AND itg.TmpCName like '%'||#{TmpCName}||'%'

SELECT ac.seqno ,AC.BUSI_DATE busiDate,AC.END_TIME,DECODE(NVL(LOG.ERROR,0),0,'02','09') STATUS ,
CASE WHEN LOG.TMP_NAME in ('ftp-download','sftp-download') THEN CASE WHEN NVL(LOG.ERROR,0)!=0 AND NVL(LOG.SUCCESS,0)=0 THEN '文件不存在' WHEN NVL(LOG.ERROR,0) =0 AND NVL(LOG.SUCCESS,0)!=0 then '下载成功' END ELSE DECODE(NVL(LOG.ERROR,0),0,'执行成功'||LOG.success||'条','执行成功'||nvl(LOG.success,0)||'条,失败'||nvl(LOG.ERROR,0)||'条') END detailAction
,NVL(GR.TASK_GRP_NAME,LOG.FILE_NAME) taskCname,
log.TMP_NAME EName,ac.START_TIME startTime FROM ( SELECT TMP_NAME,FILE_NAME,PARENT_SEQNO, DECODE(IS_CHECK,'Y',COUNT(1),0) SUCCESS,DECODE(IS_CHECK,'N',COUNT(1),0) ERROR FROM VAL_INTERFLOG GROUP BY TMP_NAME,FILE_NAME,PARENT_SEQNO,IS_CHECK )LOG left join ( SELECT TASK_GRP_ID, TASK_GRP_NAME FROM bok_BATCH_TASK_GRP GROUP BY TASK_GRP_ID, TASK_GRP_NAME ) GR on GR.TASK_GRP_ID = LOG.TMP_NAME LEFT JOIN VAL_INTERF_ACTIONLOG AC ON AC.SEQNO=LOG.PARENT_SEQNO WHERE AC.SEQNO = #{seqno}
